notes: The crawl is capped at 10 pages to keep the brief quick, so a large shop may still have aisles left — add anything missing in the app editor.
The site lists items without prices, so they appear as “Ask on request” until you set one.

Their look is measured, not copied: the palette, typeface and corner radius are read from their stylesheet and applied to an app we build. Their markup, scripts and images stay on their server — a packaged copy would be their copyright, and it would break the first time it went offline or they redeployed.

Photos are not copied from the site: they usually belong to the owner or their supplier, and hotlinking them breaks the offline app. The build uses its own generated artwork until real images are uploaded.

Cleared 9 prices that looked like a reading error, so the item shows no price until you set one: Emergency Maintenance & Repairs London at 1000, Landlord Maintenance Services in London at 1000, Appliance Services London at 1000, Air Conditioning Services at 1000, Commercial Heating Engineers in London at 1000, Commercial Plumbers in London at 1000, Commercial Electricians in London at 1000, Commercial Drainage Services in London at 1000, Commercial Carpentry London at 1000.
